facts.summary: Paid summer internship on David Yurman's Creative Visual Services team creating 3D concepts for windows, store installations, fixtures and events.
facts.duties: Build Rhino models and photoreal renders of displays and fixtures; prepare presentations, technical drawings and fabrication documentation; turn sketches and direction into developed concepts; research materials and fabrication methods.
facts.requirements: Rhino or similar 3D modeling; rendering software and Photoshop/Illustrator; eye for form, color and material; 3D printing/laser cutting a plus.
facts.apply: Apply on David Yurman Workday (canApply true, posted ~Oct 21).
